question: Can price changes be algebraically separated into vendor PE and implied earnings without confusing per-share, total-share and adjusted-price bases?
scope: Exact preceding calendar month per security, retain all R112 monthly rows and statuses; no industry aggregation or forward prediction in this basis audit
validity: Both months completed benchmark month ends, listed and finite positive raw price/PE. Total basis additionally finite positive cap/shares, effective_share_date <= date and cap identity; qfq additionally positive finite and same nonmissing chain. Retain failure status; no forward fill, no dropping nonpositive PE from full stock denominator.
flags: Share change and adjustment wedge marked at fixed numerical abs(logchange)>1e-10, not trading/selection thresholds; report cross-tab and absolute wedge quantiles, annual counts; direction disagreement per-share vs total implied earnings using numerical zero band1e-10
interpretation: All identities are algebra, not causal evidence. P/PE and cap/PE are vendor-implied quantities, not validated actual earnings; adjustment wedge not automatically cash dividends or certified total return. Historical proxy, no initial-publication PIT.
validation: Independent exact source reindex, all status masks, log difference identities and summaries; synthetic split and cash-distribution examples, chain break, negative PE and missing preceding month; no model fitting/search
